messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: The platform cannot verify third-party bank details before processing claims, causing payment delays.
  quote: we’re seeing delays in claims payments because we can’t verify third-party bank details ahead of time.
- problem: Payment detail checking is cumbersome and causing delays.
  quote: One thing we’ve struggled with is payment detail checking — it’s causing delays.
- problem: Recurring delays due to third‑party payee account verification.
  quote: we’ve got a recurring issue with third-party payee account verification causing delays
- problem: The platform cannot verify third‑party bank details before processing payments, leading to bounced transactions.
  quote: We can’t verify bank details ahead of time, which causes bounces.
- problem: Payments are being delayed within the platform.
  quote: we’ve been struggling with some payment ... delays lately.
- problem: Payee account verification is not performed before funds are released, leading to re‑issuance delays and supplier timeline issues.
  quote: We’ve also noticed that payee account verification isn’t happening before funds are released — it’s causing unnecessary re-issuance delays and affecting our supplier timelines.
- problem: Customers cannot verify third‑party bank information before issuing payments, leading to bounced payments and re‑issues.
  quote: Right now, we can’t verify third-party bank info before paying — so payments bounce and we reissue days later. We’re currently facing delays because we can’t validate third-party bank details before sending payments — that’s why we’re reissuing them days later, and payment detail checking is the core issue.
- problem: Delays in payment detail checking are slowing down claim processing.
  quote: We’ve had too many delays from payment detail checking.
